behavior_constraints: New `graph` subcommand registered in main, invoked as `jobforge graph --spec <path> [--format dot|mermaid] [--only <names>]`
Default --format is dot; values other than dot|mermaid cause exit 2 with stderr-only `error: bad --format\n` and empty stdout
graph uses the same validation path as plan/run/validate/list: invalid spec exits 2 with stderr-only `error: <code>: <message>\n` and empty stdout
Missing --spec exits 2 with non-empty `error: ...` on stderr and empty stdout
Any unsupported flag (e.g. --results, --on-failure, bare positionals) exits 2 with non-empty `error: ...` on stderr and empty stdout
graph does not execute any job command and does not touch any working directory on disk
Nodes emitted in level-major, byte-wise lexicographic within-level (case-sensitive) walk order, matching list
Edges emitted as `dep -> name` grouped by dependent node in walk order, within each node in spec-declared deps order

DOT format: line1 `digraph jobforge {`, line2 `\trankdir=LR;`, then one `\t"<name>" [level="<N>",workdir="<workdir>"];` per job in walk order, then one `\t"<dep>" -> "<name>";` per edge, final line `}` with exactly one trailing newline
DOT attribute order is level then workdir, single comma no spaces; workdir is resolved default `/app` applied when omitted
entities.summary: Add a read-only `graph` subcommand emitting the DAG in DOT or Mermaid text formats with the same validation, walk order, and --only filter semantics as list, without executing any jobs.

instruction_head:
# jobforge graph output

Add a new read-only subcommand, `graph`, that emits the DAG in two
textual graph formats (DOT and Mermaid). The binary is still built with
`go build -o /usr/local/bin/jobforge ./cmd/jobforge` and invoked as
`jobforge <subcommand> --spec <path>`.

All existing behavior — including `plan`, `run`, `validate`,
`list` (with `--only`), the 11-row validation precedence table, byte-level
results file format, globally lex-smallest multi-SCC cycle path,
case-sensitive byte-wise wi
